title: Optimize a Large List with Virtual Scrolling
description: Take a list of 10,000 items and convert it to use virtual scrolling.
problemStatement:
## Problem Statement

You are given a component that displays 10,000 items using a simple `v-for`. This causes performance issues. Refactor it to use a virtual scroller.

- Use the provided starter code (or write from scratch) with a list of 10,000 items.
- Implement a basic virtual scroller manually (as shown in the lesson) or use a library like `vue-virtual-scroller`. For this task, implement your own to understand the concept.
- The items should have a fixed height (e.g., 40px).
- Show only the items that fit in the viewport plus a small buffer.
- Ensure smooth scrolling and proper updating of visible items.

**Bonus**: Add a feature that dynamically changes item heights or supports variable heights (more advanced).
hints:
Use a container div with `overflow-y: auto` and a fixed height.
    Inside, use a spacer div to set total height.
    Compute `startIndex` based on scrollTop and item height.
    Render only a slice of items, positioning them absolutely or using a wrapper.
    Update `startIndex` on scroll event.
expectedOutput: A smoothly scrolling list of 10,000 items that renders only ~20 DOM elements at a time.
